manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Watch a tossed ball slow to a momentary stop at the top and fall, while gravity pulls downward continuously.
manifest.description: A vertical height scale shows a ball launched upward. A blue motion arrow shrinks during the rise, vanishes at the top, and points down on the fall. A dashed warm gravity arrow points down throughout.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
